one_line: Community messaging platform with a very broad REST API, Gateway WebSocket, webhooks, and bot framework for building apps that run inside servers.
auth_notes: Bot tokens and OAuth2 with scopes; apps created free in the Discord developer portal with no approval for unverified public bots.
self_serve_notes: Free self-serve; create application/bot in developer portal in minutes. Privileged intents need verification for large apps only.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across messages, channels, guilds, users, interactions, and more; plus Gateway (WebSocket), webhooks, and SDKs.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks fully supported for posting messages and bot interactions; plus Gateway for real-time events.

existing_mcp.note: Official Discord MCP server exists; many community MCP servers also available.

evidence.note: Fetched text (026_discord.txt) is a thin landing page; detailed API/auth/MCP facts from strong knowledge.

agent_notes: Thin fetched text; content based on established Discord developer documentation.
